snippet.title: CHAO5: The UN-Balance Mod Returns | v2.1.0 TRAILER | 3 YEAR ANNIVERSARY
snippet.description:
CHAO5: The UN-Balance Mod Returns presents another early pre-release trailer for v2.1.0 in order to celebrate our 3 year anniversary. This update add three new fighters, updated shield damage effects, and new stage alts.

Download: https://gamebanana.com/mods/380870
Discord: https://discord.gg/Md9qKcy
My Twitter: https://twitter.com/TheOmniDoctor
mRama's Twitter: https://x.com/mRama3415
Kybbler's Twitter: https://x.com/KylesCatalog

Timestamps:
0:00 Intro Card
0:10 Funky Kong
1:11 Sans
1:54 Bandana Dee
2:37 Improved Giga Bowser
3:16 Updated Shield Damage Effects
3:57 New Alt Stages
6:47 Outro Card

Music:
